name: 代码管理
description: 工作面板里的代码管理：①②③④⑤ 全部五块（环境检查与一键安装、SSH 密钥与连接、代码管理含同步与建库、克隆仓库、npm 发布向导），另加「总览」页与 GitRepo / GitIndex 两个 agent 工具。移植自 DSH 插件 source-code-mgmt（MIT，出处与声明见 THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md）；本移植版与上游作者无从属关系。

en.name: Source Code Mgmt
en.description: Source control in the work panel: all five sections (environment check with one-click installs, SSH keys and connection, repo management with sync and repo creation, cloning, npm publish wizard), plus an index page and the GitRepo / GitIndex agent tools. A port of the DSH plugin source-code-mgmt (MIT; see THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md). This port is not affiliated with the upstream author.
en.safetyNotes: Every external command (git / ssh / ssh-keygen / gh / npm / curl / reg / winget / msiexec) runs as an absolute path with argument arrays, never a shell string and never through a shell. It writes only to its own data directory, to the repository's .gitignore, and to ~/.ssh/config when you press the write button (the target Host block is rewritten in place, no duplicate blocks, other blocks and the file's own line endings preserved, the previous file backed up first, result chmod 0600; a block's existing IdentityFile is kept unless you explicitly pick another key, so the two platforms never borrow each other's key). SSH keys are created only inside ~/.ssh and never leave the machine. One-click installs really run the system installers (winget / msiexec / Add-WindowsCapability / apt / brew); when elevation is needed the plugin launches Start-Process -Verb RunAs and you must accept the UAC prompt — it never elevates silently in the background. npm login opens a new terminal window and runs npm login there, so the password is handled by npm's own TTY and never touches the plugin; npm is invoked through node + npm-cli.js, publishing always targets the official registry.npmjs.org, and credentials from npm config list are masked to ****** before display. It registers exactly two agent tools: GitRepo (reads status/diff/log/branches/bigFiles; writes stage/unstage/commit/checkout/push/pull/mergePush/pushStaged/init/createRepo/setVisibility/revert/cherryPick/ignoreBig; align/forcePush/forcePull require an explicit confirm flag and ask the user first) and GitIndex (index local repos, clone). Network access is limited to gitee.com (your pasted personal token, stored 0600 in the plugin data directory), api.github.com (version lookups), and the npm / gh calls you trigger yourself. Cloning uses a validated URL and refuses to overwrite an existing path. No telemetry, no background service.

zh-CN.name: 代码管理
zh-CN.description: 工作面板里的代码管理：①②③④⑤ 全部五块（环境检查与一键安装、SSH 密钥与连接、代码管理含暂存提交/同步/建库、克隆仓库、npm 发布向导），另加「总览」页（汇总本机仓库、标出同一远程的多个副本）与 GitRepo / GitIndex 两个 agent 工具。移植自 DSH 插件 source-code-mgmt（MIT；出处与声明见 THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md）；本移植版与上游作者无从属关系。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 所有外部命令（git / ssh / ssh-keygen / gh / npm / curl / reg / winget / msiexec）一律按绝对路径以参数数组方式启动，不拼 shell 字符串、不经 shell。写盘范围：插件自己的数据目录；仓库内的 .gitignore；以及仅在你按按钮时才写 ~/.ssh/config（目标 Host 块就地改写，不产生重复块、不动其它块、保留文件自身换行符，先备份原文件，结果 chmod 0600；除非你显式选中另一把密钥，该块原有的 IdentityFile 原样保留，两个平台不会互相借钥匙）。SSH 密钥只在 ~/.ssh 内生成，绝不离机。一键安装会真的调用系统安装器（winget / msiexec / Add-WindowsCapability / apt / brew），需要管理员权限时通过 Start-Process -Verb RunAs 弹出 UAC，你必须点确认才会继续；插件不会在后台静默提权。npm 登录通过打开一个新终端窗口执行 npm login，密码由 npm 自己的 TTY 处理，插件不接触；npm 调用优先走 node + npm-cli.js，发布固定使用官方源 registry.npmjs.org，config list 中的凭据在显示前被抹成 ******。仅注册两个 agent 工具：GitRepo（读 status/diff/log/branches/bigFiles；写 stage/unstage/commit/checkout/push/pull/mergePush/pushStaged/init/createRepo/setVisibility/revert/cherryPick/ignoreBig；align/forcePush/forcePull 必须显式 confirm 并先询问用户）与 GitIndex（汇总本机仓库、克隆）。网络仅访问 gitee.com（用你粘贴的私人访问令牌，0600 存在插件数据目录）、api.github.com（版本查询）以及你自己按下按钮触发的 npm / gh。克隆用校验过的地址，目标已存在时直接拒绝。无遥测、无后台驻留服务。

agentTools.name: GitRepo
agentTools.description: 读/操作一个本地 git 仓库：status / diff / log / branches / bigFiles，以及 stage / unstage / commit / checkout / push / pull / mergePush / pushStaged / init / createRepo / setVisibility / revert / cherryPick / ignoreBig；align / forcePush / forcePull 需要 confirm 且应先问用户。

agentTools.name: GitIndex
agentTools.description: 汇总本机 git 仓库（含同一远程的多个副本）并把远程仓库克隆到指定目录。
